label: report the length in bits rather than characters
find:
"V8: Initial %s message length is %d octets\r\n",
		    v->mode == 1 ? "JM" : "CM", words);
replace:
"V8: Initial %s message length is %d octets\r\n",
		    v->mode == 1 ? "JM" : "CM", words * V8_SEQ_BITS_PER_WORD);

label: swap JM and CM in the length banner
swap the two extension BUG messages
drop the no-call-function BUG message
announce the length before the tail is counted
